deduplication.identity: SHA-256 of exact original payload bytes, independent of name, role or mode. One regular tar payload per distinct SHA; no symlink/hardlink or repeated content copy.
deduplication.aliases: source_inputs and reference_map preserve every selected original absolute/local reference, per-source byte length, SHA, permission mode and role; multiple aliases can point to one member.
deduplication.mode: Each tar member uses its designated canonical source mode. If aliases differ in mode, restore the alias mode from reference_map/source_inputs; no original source mode is changed.
deduplication.shared_assets: Unchanged base harness, decoder adapter, fake CLI, wire specimen and cleanup source occur once under shared/assets. Old b27/current b248 harnesses and old/current controlcontracts remain distinct exact payloads.
deduplication.canonical_bytes: Read directly as binary bytes; no terminal LF loss, line-ending conversion, redaction, ref rewriting or JSON reserialization of original payloads.
deduplication.format: Deterministic gzip(mtime=0, level9) over sorted regular-file USTAR entries (uid/gid0, empty user/group, mtime0). Archive contains payload-manifest.json plus unique original payloads.
